text: The Rusty Captain's Hook are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Rotting Mire Salvage.
Rylakstalker's Piercing Fangs is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Rylakstalker's Fangs.
Rylak-Scale Vest drops from Amaukwa in Moonflower Valley in .
Rylakstalker's Confounding Strikes is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Rylakstalker's Strikes.
Ruthless Gladiator's Mark of Tenacity was never made available to players.
Rynaam is a centaur flight master located at Forkriver Crossing in the Ohn'ahran Plains.

Rustpine Cones are found in the trees of Winterpelt Hollow in the Azure Span. They can be collected by flying through them. Kranac Sagesnow wants 12 of them in Ursol's Wisdom, part of the Skill 100 portion of the Winterpelt Furbolg storyline.
Ryala is the wolf mount of Aggralan, located alongside Moonpaw, Spring, and Winter in Frostwolf Keep in Alterac Valley during A People in Need of Healing. They are named after Ryal, Aggra's mother.

Were you looking for: * Ruul Eagletalon at Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore? – OR – * Ruul Onestone southwest of Stromgarde Keep in the Arathi Highlands? – OR – * Ruul Snowhoof at Thistlefur Hold in Ashenvale Forest? – OR – * Ruul the Darkener in Shadowmoon Valley?

SI:7 (Stormwind Intelligence or Stormwind Intelligence Agency) also spelled SI-7, is a secretive military force of Stormwind's sovereign monarch. It includes rogues specializing in special operations, espionage, assassination and stealth tactics. It is referred to as Stormwind's most elite covert force, the Alliance's intelligence agency, and Azeroth's most elite spy organization. The organization is currently led by Master Mathias Shaw. SI:7 is located in the building with the same name in the Old Town quarter of Stormwind City. They have operatives all throughout the Eastern Kingdoms who carry out secret missions for Stormwind, such as Renzik "The Shiv" and Flint Shadowmore. They also have
"Stay Out!!!" is a book in Dalaran which can spawn in place of the book "The Schools of Arcane Magic".
SPH is a game term that stands for Spell Power: Holy. For example, you might see it listed in the calculation for Exorcism on the [http://www.wowhead.com/?spell=48801 wowhead fansite].

Sable Ridge, formerly part of the Bitter Reaches, has been claimed by the Black Dragonflight. By the time of the Burning Legion's third invasion, Raethas Dawnseer commented that the ruins looked like the goblins already picked them clean.
Saari is a tiger located at the Shrine of Seven Stars. The tiger likes to chase after the rat named Squeakers.
SMCKTHAT.EXE is an ability used by Blingtron pets during a Pet Battle.
The vicious saberon are a cat-like race native to Draenor. They are almost universally hostile and territorial to all factions on the planet.
Sabermaw Bluff is a cliff in southwestern Val'sharah overlooking the Wretched Hollow and Steelclaw Vale. At the top of the bluff lies the Wileywisp Den and a moonwell.
Sablehide Boots is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
Sablehide Breeches is a quest reward from Spread Your Lunarwings and Fly.
Indicates a spell or ability has a new icon. SPELL_UPDATE_ICON

Listening Device.]] Three SI:7 Listening Devices are located around Warfang Hold in the Stormsong Valley during the Horde War Campaign. Each is powered by an :Azerite crystal and operated by SI:7 Technicians.
Sabertron Assemble is a quest achievement earned by destroying each color of Sabertron in Stormsong Valley.
Sable Jaguar Specimens are jaguars located outside the Black Morass in the Caverns of Time. They have been frozen in time by the bronze dragonflight.
Sabatons of Malevolent Intent drop from Il'gynoth, Corruption Reborn in Ny'alotha, the Waking City.
__NOTOC__ Sable Enforcer is a black drakonid located in Island Expeditions.

SH in World of Warcraft may represent one of the following: * Stonehearth Graveyard, Stonehearth Outpost, Stonehearth Bunker and Captain Balinda Stonehearth in Alterac Valley. * Sentinel Hill, an alliance outpost in Westfall. * Sorrow Hill, an area in southern Western Plaguelands. * Shattered Halls, a 5-man level 70 instance in the Hellfire Peninsula. * Sethekk Halls, a 5-man level 70 instance in Auchindoun. * Scarlet Halls, a 5-man instance in Scarlet Monastery.

__NOTOC__ Sageclaw is a dagger which can be bought by Alliance players from The League of Arathor. According Mathias Shaw, many veterans of the Arathi Basin tell stories about this dagger combining steel and magic that saved their lives.

__NOTOC__ Sagorne Creststrider is a tauren shaman trainer located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. Before the Shattering, he was located in Grommash Hold. After Vol'jin's death, he was seen speaking with Tatepi and Terga Earthbreaker.

Sacrificial Gauntlets are a fairly common drop from any of the Aspect Priests in Zul'Gurub. Although they are only of rare quality, they are among the most powerful gauntlets available at this stage of the game for warriors wishing to deal damage in instances.

Sagefish Delight is an exceptional bit of food for healers and caster DPS. Sagefish Delight is generally most valuable during long boss encounters that are mana intensive. Combined with other items such as Mageblood Potion and Brilliant Mana Oil, a caster even in mediocore gear can have very good mana regeneration.

The Sacred Grove is a well-hidden glade deep in northwestern Ammen Vale, concealed by two mountains and thick trees. The entrance is blocked by the Spirit of the Vale. It is inhabited by many elementals of all sorts in conflict with each other, and is used as a test area for draenei shamans who want to learn their totems.
Sacrificial Robes was a drop from Morganth, a level 26 human warlock found inside the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains prior to Cataclysm.

Sahaak is an arakkoa specialty goods vendor located in a building on the island in Blackwind Lake in Terokkar Forest. To be able to buy and trade with Sahaak, you need to do the quest A Shabby Disguise. You will be required to get an arakkoa disguise.

The sacrificial pits of Azjol-Nerub were used long ago to sacrifice enemy forces in exchange for success in battle. They are now used by acolytes of the Scourge who wish to serve as the eyes and ears of Ner'zhul, allowing them to shed their bodies and take on the forms of invisible shades. Shades are detectable only by magic, making them excellent spies.

A Sagefish School is a fishing pool which primarily contains Raw Sagefish. These schools can be found in the inland waters of Ashenvale, Azshara (except the Ruins of Arkkoran), Darkshore, Duskwood, Hillsbrad Foothills, Loch Modan, Northern Barrens (except the oasis), Redridge Mountains, Silverpine Forest, Westfall and Wetlands.

Sacrificed Aspirants can be found dead near the freshly-resurrected Black Knight on his ledge at Deathspeaker's Watch in Icecrown. They are apparently being used to channel some kind of power in to the Knight. Most likely, the aspirants were led to the watch by Kul the Reckless and were too late for players to save during the daily quest You've Really Done It This Time, Kul.
Salha is a draenei Aldor priest trainer located at the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.

The Sakhet Wastes is a large wasteland in northern Uldum stretching to the northern Pilgrim's Precipice, western Maker's Ascent, southwestern Obelisk of the Moon, southern Seal of the Sun King and eastern river (Vir'naal Oasis). The wastes are filled with Wastewander bandits, scorpids, and the bones of many dead creatures.

__NOTOC__ Sahi Cloudsinger is an elder tauren shaman trainer located in the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar. She was present at the funeral ceremony of Vol'jin in the Dranosh'ar Blockade. Sahi taught Zekhan some shamanic skills. Later, she was no longer accepting new students, and when he asked her about it, she demonstrated that she still wielded elemental power.
Salirn Moonbear is a night elf innkeeper found at the Grove of Aessina in Mount Hyjal.

Sage Whiteheart is a representative of and quartermaster for the August Celestials sent to the Shrine of Seven Stars to enlist Alliance aid. He can be found on the lower level of the Summer Terrace. He will offer his daily quests only to those who have attained status with the Golden Lotus. He appears as a mob in the Vale of Eternal Twilight.

Sage Lotusbloom is a pandaren quartermaster vendor with the August Celestials. She is located on the lower level of the Golden Terrace at the Shrine of Two Moons. She will offer daily quests only to those who have attained status with the Golden Lotus.

Salabria is one of three blood elven destroyers used by the Sunreaver Onslaught to lay claim to the Isle of Thunder. Until the Horde claims Zeb'tula, she is anchored west of the Court of Bones in the Greymist Firth north of The Crimson Treader and The Starchaser, the other two ships. The ship leaves after The Assault on Zeb'tula is takes place.
Sadi is a blood elf woman that can be found in the Summer's Rest inn, inside the Shrine of Two Moons. She stands next to Erin; both provide indications for the various services of the Shrine.
Sabre of the Faceless Moon is a world drop from level 92 - 95 mobs.
Sage Behofomat is a draenei enchanting vendor located at the Shattrath City Center in Talador. Once becomes occupied, his whereabouts are unknown.
Sacrificial Pact is a death knight ability that sacrifices the death knight's ghoul to inflict AoE shadow damage to their enemies and heal themselves for a portion of their maximum health.

Sakrul the Brewbrul is a drogbar beverage or "drog" vendor who appears on the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain after completing Unexpected Allies. He is standing at a bar labeled "The Drog Bar".
The Sacred Stone is found in a cave in Krokul Hovel in Krokuun. It lets the Broken hear the whispers of the planet, which steadies their hearts.
Sack of Plunder is a possible reward from island expeditions.
Sacks of Azerite are bags of :Azerite found in Kunza-Kunza on the Uncharted Island.
Sahale Wisehorn is a Highmountain tauren located at Ironmaul Overlook in Stormsong Valley.
The Sack of Dried Star Moss is located next to Elric Whalgrene in Boralus and Clever Kumali in Dazar'alor.
Sabotaged Shredders are shredders destroyed by SI:7 Technicians and SI:7 Operatives in the Clearcut in Stormsong Valley during the War Campaign.
Sacrificial Soul-Ash is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sacrificial Vermin is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sadana's Grisly Visage drops from Sadana Bloodfury in Shadowmoon Burial Grounds.
__NOTOC__ Sagescale Sigil is an optional crafting reagent from used in Dragon Isles Inscription to make Darkmoon Cards; taught by Technique: Sagescale Sigil.

.]]__NOTOC__ The Salty Sailor Tavern is the local tavern and inn located in Booty Bay and is run by Innkeeper Skindle. It can be visited during the Kirin Tor Tavern Crawl. The local specialty is the South Island Iced Tea.
Samuel Van Brunt is a Forsaken blacksmithing vendor located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

Sam Lantinga, also known as slouken (all lowercase), is a former Blizzard Lead Software Engineer. He created the World of Warcraft UI addon system, and has also worked on spells, AI, and gameplay systems such as phasing and battlegrounds. He frequently posted help and updates regarding the World of Warcraft UI, and was very much involved with the community. On January 4th, 2011, Sam Lantinga announced that he had recently left Blizzard Entertainment to work exclusively on his business, Galaxy Gameworks, and the SDL.

Samuel Hawke is a PvP vendor located at Refuge Pointe in the Arathi Highlands. He is the League of Arathor' supply officer and stands outside the entrance to the Arathi Basin. There are many veterans of the Arathi Basin who know Samuel Hawke well, he is the one who rewards their talents as combatants by distributing armor, weapons and magical objects of all kinds, so that they are even better protected on the battlefield. Alliance players can buy special items from him using a combination of honor points and Arathi Basin Marks of Honor. Due to the level banding that occurs in battlegrounds, many of these items have multiple versions with the same name. For example, there are four versions of

Saltspray Glen is a small area in the northwestern Wetlands bordered by Bluegill Marsh to the south, Ironbeard's Tomb to the east, and Baradin Bay to the north and west. Like Black Channel Marsh, Whelgar's Excavation Site, and Raptor Ridge, Saltspray Glen is crawling with the numerous raptors who nest here. The glen is so named for the ease with which the ocean throws seawater inland here when there is a strong wind blowing off from the bay.
Salt Flats Scavengers are vultures found at The Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles. They have a heavily damaging Execute ability much like a warrior's.
__NOTOC__ Salt Flats Vultures are drowned vultures found in the Shimmering Deep in Thousand Needles. Before the Cataclysm, they were found flying in the Shimmering Flats.

Samul Strangehands is one of Brann Bronzebeard's mentors, who later joined him in founding the Explorers' Guild. "An experienced veteran of the First and Second Wars, by avocation Samul is a renowned stonecarver and sculptor who gained a taste for the outdoors wandering the mountains of Khaz Modan in search of raw material for his statues. Always trying to evoke the fiery spirit of his people in his art, he was fascinated to discover that the titans may have lit that spark long ago. In search of the truth, he was among those who founded the Explorer’s Guild to go in search of titan artifacts that might uncover the heritage of the dwarven race. Though Samul is a trusted advisor to the High Ex
The Sample of Primal Mooncloth is obtained through the use of the Vial of Primal Reagents.

Salramm the Fleshcrafter is a necromancer and the second boss of Culling of Stratholme, an instance introduced in Wrath of the Lich King. In Warcraft III: Reforged, he was added into The Culling, hiding within one of Stratholme's houses and ambushing Arthas's forces once the house is destroyed.
Salvaging Life's Strength is a side quest in the Waygate quest chain.
The Saltspittle tribe is a tribe of murlocs previously found near Lake Falathim in Ashenvale. Their members abandoned the area when giant tendrils began spawning from the ground after the Shattering.
Saltwater Starfish are looted from Saltwater Stars in Kelp'thar Forest.
Sambino's Modified Strength of Earth Totem can be obtained from The Great Sambino during Totem Modification.

Salvager's Bag is a quest reward from Salvage the Supplies which begins with Gwen Armstead in the Merchant Square of Gilneas City. To complete the quest, you must bring four Salvaged Supplies to Gwen Armstead.
San'shigo is a jungle troll flight master located at the Gullet in the Twilight Highlands.

.]] Rusty Anvil is an anvil located in the ships The Briny Cutter and The Immortal Coil in the Kelp'thar Forest and near Schnottz's Landing in Uldum. The chest provides adventurers with an opportunity to vendor items and purchase reagents or other items.

__NOTOC__ Salsbury the "Help" is a gnome quest giver located at Farwatcher's Glen in Stonetalon Mountains who appears to be a fan of the citizens of Gilneas who have turned into worgen. In addition to being dressed like a Gilnean, he believes that if he manages to gain Hierophant Malyk's trust, he will transform Salsbury into a worgen (or, as he expresses it, "the world's first gnomegen").

__NOTOC__ Salt-Flop is a murloc quest giver located on the cliff above the southern edge of the Shattershore of the Blasted Lands. He is a member of the Rockpool tribe. He ran away with several tadpoles when the Rockpool murlocs were attacked by Bloodwash naga. He asks those passing by to check on the murlocs that did not escape. He has the Amulet of Sevine in his possession, for reasons unknown. He does not appear to have a great attachment to it, as he has no qualms with giving it to a stranger passing by. It is unknown what happened with him when Thrall and the Horde made a camp from his location.

Salty Sea Dog is sold by Stamp Thunderhorn at the Darkmoon Faire. The fish used are Great Sea Herring, which is then deep fried and put inside a crusty sausage roll in the place of a wiener or sausage. It would seem that just one herring is the perfect fit for each roll.
Salty Futz is a gnome fighting Iron Horde Grunts alongside many others at the Dark Portal in Blasted Lands and Tanaan Jungle. He died after the portal was destroyed.

:Not to be confused with Samara, the White Widow. Samaara is the older sister of Yrel initially found in Embaari Village. Yrel can only remember being cared for by Samaara; it is unknown what happened to their parents. After reuniting with her sister, Samaara goes to fight against the . She was captured by at Teluuna Observatory and taken into Shaz'gul. By the time Yrel, the Alliance commander, and Prophet Velen rescued her at the Terrace of the Stars, she was beyond saving. She gave her little sister loving encouragement to be strong before passing away, her soul leaving her mortal shell and disappearing. This becomes the turning point for Yrel, who vows to become strong to protect their pe
Salt Elementals are elementals made of salt found on a small overlook of the Tangleheart in Gorgrond. They can only be reached with flight or with the Lumber Yard's shredder.
Saltbeak Snappers can be found on the Gloaming Reef islands off the coast of Val'sharah.

Salute to StarCraft is a feat of strength celebrating 20 years of StarCraft. Summon or find one of the five StarCraft-themed battle pets and /salute it between March 31 and April 6, 2018, to earn the feat.
Salvaged Mechagnome Appendages drop from Sentry Ambushers and Malfunctioning Appendage on Mechagon Island.

Sambino's Modified Earth Elemental Totem is a special type of totem that was modified magically and technologically, being made out of metal with a working drill below it. They also spawn a Modified Earth Elemental.
__NOTOC__ Saltfin is a murloc who can be encountered on Island Expeditions.
Salt-Stained Tuskarr Gloves drop from Flotsam in Highmountain.
Salty Deckhands are humans located on the Rugged Dragonscale in Stormwind City.
__NOTOC__ Salt Deposit is a cooking ingredient in Dragonflight Cooking which can only be gathered by players with the Mining profession.
__NOTOC__ Salukan is a centaur flight master located atop the Shikaar rise in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains and the Nokhud Offensive.

__NOTOC__ Sandahl is a human warlock trainer located in the cellar of the Slaughtered Lamb pub in the Mage Quarter in Stormwind City. As part of a warlock quest-chain, an Alliance warlock will need to seek Sandahl, in order to get some information about the Council of the Black Harvest.
The Sandfury Coin is a Paragon of Power sought after by the Zandalar Tribe.

The Sanctum of the Sun is an arcane sanctum located to the southeast of Tranquillien in the Ghostlands. Still in working order, the magisters who are tending to the arcane sanctum give adventurers tasks related to saving the Ghostlands from the Scourge and other invaders. The building is guarded by a few Ghostlands Guardians. Behind the building, there is a secret passage through the mountains to Tranquillien, which saves time when travelling between the two areas.

Sanctity of Battle is a passive paladin ability, available at level 58. It lowers the cooldown and global cooldown of your Holy Shock, Judgment, Crusader Strike, Hammer of Wrath, Hammer of the Righteous, Consecration, Holy Wrath, Avenger's Shield, Shield of the Righteous and Exorcism.

.]] .]] The Sanctuary of Malorne is an ancient shrine to the demigod Malorne that was destroyed by the invading fire elementals. It is located just south of Ashen Lake and northwest of Sulfuron Spire in Mount Hyjal. After completing the quest Aessina's Miracle the area known as the Flamewake becomes part of the Regrowth and the shrine is rebuilt.

__NOTOC__ Sandfury Blood Drinkers are sand trolls found within their capital Zul'Farrak as well as in Tanaris. They use blood magic. They assisted Hydromancer Kulratha and tried to protect Kai'ju Gahz'rilla during the Elemental Unrest.

Sand Pygmies are pygmies found near the Obelisk of the Stars in Uldum. Some of them are found dead. During the Assault in Uldum, the pygmies fall victim to a flock of Arid Bonepickers led by Rotfeaster.
Sand Pygmy Corpse is a pygmy located at the Obelisk of the Stars in Uldum. He is killed when crushed by a chest falling from the sky, which was occupied by the adventurer.
Sand Bolt is an ability used by Living Sandling during a Pet Battle.

__NOTOC__ The Sanctum of Enlightenment is a large building complex located in the north of the nightborne Suramar City. Located on the Terrace of Enlightenment and Grand Promenade, it is similar in size and appearance to the Sanctum of Order a short distance away, though access is not open to the general public. A large arcane elevator provides instantaneous transport to the building's uppermost level from the Terrace of Enlightenment. The sanctum is occupied by the Duskwatch, Suramar's peacekeeping force, though little is known of its exact purpose. Both the name, as well as many of the statues found outside, seem to indicate the sanctum acts as some sort of arcane library or similar reposi
Sanctified Scrolls were sold for by Alanaa during Island Expeditions.

Sandfury Trolls are sand trolls that accompany General Jakra'zet at the Blood Font below Atul'Aman in Vol'dun. At the start of Defeat Jakra'zet, Jakra'zet sacrifices all of the Sandfury Trolls present with blood magic, killing them instantly.

Sandfury Reserve is located on top of a pillar in the ruined central building of the Sandfury Hideout in Vol'dun. Without flying, it can only be reached by running to the south side of the building, onto the roof, and out onto the pillar.
Sandspinner Eggs are spider eggs located in the Arid Basin and the Court of Zak'rajan in Vol'dun. Destroying them releases Spiderlings and Sandspinner Spiderlings, respectively.
Sanctifying Totems are totems created by Princess Talanji to cleanse the blood magic in Nazmir.
Sandskitter the Relentless is a crab located in Island Expeditions.

The Sanctum Door is the entrance into the main hall of the Seat of the Primus, located at the top of the Bleak Redoubt in Maldraxxus. It is initially sealed shut, but over the course of the Maldraxxus storyline, players gradually empower each of the door's five runes with the Blade of the Primus before finally opening it during The Door to the Unknown. It remains permanently open for players who join the Necrolord Covenant.

The Sanctum report is a window that keeps track of the player's calling quests, adventures, and soulbind powers. It has a secondary "companions" tab that displays information about adventure companions and troops.
Sands of Desperation is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Sanctimonial Rod is a quest reward from A Hero's Welcome (Classic) which starts with Ginro Hearthkindle in Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

Sargeron was once a night elven city, but has lain in ruins since the War of the Ancients. The town's original name has been lost to time, but its ruins are now home to numerous Hatefury satyr who have redubbed it Sargeron — after their demonic master Sargeras. The ruins were home to many holy sites of Elune, including Elune's Cathedral, Elune's Temple and Elune's Sanctuary. Several relics can still be found there, namely Elune's Brazier, Elune's Handmaiden, the Cup of Elune and the Ancient Vortex Runestone.
Sandstorm is an ability used by some pets during a Pet Battle.
Sarah Killian is a Forsaken mining vendor located in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

__NOTOC__ Sark Ragetotem is a tauren warrior trainer located on Hunter Rise in Thunder Bluff. He directs warriors to class related quests. During the Elemental Unrest, Sark defended a part of the city and warned the adventurers about the attacks.

Sara Timberlain is a human quest giver located in the Eastvale Logging Camp in Elwynn Forest. She is renowned for her tailoring abilities with salvaged cloth and has even been commissioned by the Stormwind Army to supply them with cloth and leather armor. She can be found just outside a house on the west end of the camp.
Sap Beasts are oozes found in the Stonetalon Mountains. Witch Doctor Jin'Zil wants their sap.
__NOTOC__ Sarinei Whitestar is a night elf general goods vendor located at Cenarion Refuge in Zangarmarsh.
__NOTOC__ Sanoru is a Broken quest giver located in the Warden's Cage in Shadowmoon Valley.
__NOTOC__ Sarendryana is an elite frost nymph quest giver located in Stars' Rest in Dragonblight. She uses a special purple color scheme.

__NOTOC__ Saragosa was a great blue dragon who circled high above the Nexus in Coldarra, in the Borean Tundra. She served both as guardian and prime consort to Malygos. She was Malygos's mate for at least ten thousand years. She survived Deathwing's betrayal, but her mate's madness caused them to abandon her clutch. Korialstrasz found this particular clutch of eggs, which would include Arygos and Kirygosa and safeguarded them so that the blue flight would not die out. At the time of the Nexus War, if any serious threats arose, she alerted her master of the danger. Saragosa met her death in Saragosa's End, being killed by Keristrasza. In vengeance, Malygos forced Keristrasza to be his new con

__NOTOC__ Sapphire Pigment is obtained from milling: Winterspring is an excellent source of sapphire pigment, as Mountain Silversage and Icecap grow plentifully there. Swamp of Sorrows is also good due to the presence of Sorrowmoss and Golden Sansam.

.]] Sandstorm elementals (in Ardenweald known as dust elementals) are a type of elemental that are primarily found in Vol'dun and who — as the name suggests — appear to embody both sand and lightning. With the corruption of her temple, the loa Sethraliss' command of lightning has created twisted elementals, the most powerful which is Galvazzt.

Sarah Templeworth is a chef working in the Tower of Azora under her master, Archmage Theocritus. She works hard as a chef and does not use magic. One time she had prepared a dinner for weeks and when it finally was ready, her master conjured a muffin to "add 'variety' to the meal". This incident really upset Sarah.

__NOTOC__ Sapph is a Darkfallen death knight found in Malykriss: The Vile Hold. Vereth the Cunning wants her killed for the quest The Rider of Frost. Her steed is called Icefury. Assuming to her title, she's teaching Frost Death knight abilities to the death knight adepts, similar to Amal'thazad in Acherus: The Ebon Hold.
Sapphire Spectacles are provided by Harrison Jones for By the Light of the Stars.
Sanguinary Vein is a passive specialization ability for Subtlety rogues, available at level 60.
Sanguine Fortitude is a passive specialization ability for Blood death knights, available at level 72.

A sapper's life is nasty, brutal and short. A sapper who manages to get to her objective and blow it up is lucky if she can hobble home and sew her fingers and toes back on. Gnomes realised the need for those who work with things that go boom to have some sort of protection from explosive forces. This created a brief burst of technological innovation in clumsy armor suits and weird extended arms. The result was the sapper's shield. The sapper's shield is a specially reinforced tower shield with an alchemically treated glass window. This window has the same strength as steel and is of the variety used in gnomish submersibles. The shield has two armored gauntlets on the front; from behind the
Sarah Forthright was a Forsaken Strand of the Ancients battlemaster located in the Undercity during the Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients.
Sara Lanner is a Forsaken jewelcrafting supplies vendor in the War Quarter in the Undercity.

__NOTOC__ Sarana Damir is a human ink vendor located in the Canal District (Mage Quarter section) of the city of Stormwind. She works in the shop The Scribe of Stormwind, and is responsible for the trading of various inks used in the art of inscription. The shop can be found south of the Stormwind Stockade, beside the library of the Academy of Arcane Arts and Sciences.
Sara Finkleswitch is a gnome Battle Pet Trainer located at the Shrine of Seven Stars in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

Sapmaster Vu is a pandaren quest giver in Sunset Brewgarden within the Dread Wastes. He is part of a long line of courageous (or crazy) pandaren brewmasters who brave the Dread Wastes in hopes of finding exotic ingredients to brew the best beverages. Most notably, Vu uses the amber sap from the kypari trees to make his signature Shimmering Amber-Brew. He worries that the corruption of the Sha of Fear will eventually destroy all the kypari trees and make his craft impossible. During the Dread Wastes storyline, he uncovers a Klaxxi prophecy and, convinced that it is actually a beer recipe, goes on a trip with the player, Lya of Ten Songs, and Olon the Chuggernaut to find what the prophecy/reci
Sapphire Scarabs are beetles found in the Obelisk of the Stars-phased area during Harrison Jones quest in Uldum.
The Sapling of Lore was found in the Shrine of Seven Stars before the Vale of Eternal Blossoms was defiled.
Sapphire Hive Drones are wasps flying around the Sapphire Hive in Sholazar Basin.
Sapphire Hive Wasps are wasps flying around the Sapphire Hive in Sholazar Basin.

Sang-Bo is a representative of the Shado-Pan sent to the Shrine of Two Moons to enlist Horde aid. He can be found on the lower level of the Golden Terrace. He will only offer his quest to those who have reached status with the Golden Lotus.
Saarah's Vale is a lush, flowery meadow located north of Arbor Glen in . It is home to a fairly large population of Silverpelt talbuks with a pack of Shadowmoon stalkers nearby.

__NOTOC__ Sargerei Felbinders are draenei located at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle. They have forsaken the rest of the draenei people in exchange for demonic powers. Now part of the Sargerei, they inhabit the once sacred draenei temple of Sha'naar, where they carry out Gul'dan's bidding by torturing and subjugating the souls trapped within.

__NOTOC__ Sargerei Summoners are draenei located at the Temple of Sha'naar in Tanaan Jungle. They have forsaken the rest of the draenei people in exchange for demonic power. Now part of the Sargerei, they inhabit the once sacred draenei temple and carry out 's bidding by summoning demons. They can be seen throughout the temple with Dark Felstalkers in tow.

A sapta drink is used for binding a shaman's spirit to the elements. The drink is fused with magic and allows the shaman to see the elements. Its recipe is known only by several shaman and there are several types for various types of elements. The potion needs to be drunk in a holy place. Canaga Earthcaller in Valley of Trials assisted young shaman in creating a sapta drink from Felstalker Hoofs. He directed them to Spirit Rock. Saraka the Lighteater is a Void god located at the Hall of Balance in Netherlight Temple. Saraka was once a naaru named Saa'ra, having fallen deeper into the Void state and becoming a void god. Instead of killing Saraka, the draenei confined it in Netherlight Temple for research into the Void. At the onset of the Burning Legion's third invasion of Azeroth, Prophet Velen led priests of all denominations from Azeroth to Netherlight Temple. Their combined efforts, with the help of a priest adventurer wielding a powerful artifact, managed to return Saa'ra to the Light. The purified naaru remained in Netherlight Temple after it was turned into the Class Hall for the priest Conclave.

Satyrs (sometimes pluralized as satyr) are a race of bestial demons usually sworn to the Burning Legion. They are created through the spreading of the ancient satyr curse, an affliction which originated with Xavius, a Highborne sorcerer who was destroyed and remade into a demonic form as a punishment for his failures by Sargeras during the War of the Ancients. In modern times, satyrs mostly live in various sects throughout Kalimdor and exist only to harry their hated night elf cousins and obey the will of the Legion, though others have instead sworn fealty to the Old Gods and work to spread the influence of the Emerald Nightmare.
Sathrah's Sacrifice is the 3rd quest in the The Temple of the Moon quest chain.

Sathrovarr the Corruptor is a dreadlord and part of the first boss encounter of the Sunwell Plateau raid. He has possessed the blue dragon Kalecgos, who fights players at Apex Point, above the Parhelion Plaza. While doing battle with Kalecgos, players will be transported to the Inner Veil, a shadowy realm where Kalec battles Sathrovarr in his half-elf form in an attempt to stave off his own corruption. Sathrovarr was defeated and Kalec rescued by the adventurers sent by the Shattered Sun Offensive. The Scale of the Sands is a secretive subgroup of the bronze dragonflight, led by Soridormi, prime mate of Nozdormu. Arazmodu is a member of this faction. Until patch 2.4 a friendly reputation with the faction was required to enter the Battle of Mount Hyjal.

Scalebeard's Cave was located on a tiny island in the western part of the Bay of Storms in Azshara. It was the home of the rare elite turtle Scalebeard, but he tended to not be present, usually preferring to spend his time hunting in the Great Sea.
The Scalding Pools are a series of fel lava-filled pits in mountainside of the Hand of Gul'dan.

Scalawag Point is a port located on the southern end of the island south of the Isle of Spears in the Howling Fjord. It is home to the Northsea Freebooters, which have three frigates nearby. The camp is fortified with many deadly defenses. The pirates were previously led by "Mad" Jonah Sterling, who was so paranoid that he left the relative comfort of the makeshift port to live in a cave with his pet bear. With both Alliance and Horde breathing down the necks of the freebooters, another pirate, Annie Bonn, arranged to have Sterling killed and took over the operation.

The Savage Thicket is a section of the jungle that endlessly burns with magical fire, located north of the Glimmering Pillar in the Sholazar Basin. It is bordered on the east by the Bonefields, Glimmering Pillar to the southeast, to the south by Mistwhisper Refuge, to the southwest by Dorian's Outpost, and by Spearborn Encampment to the west. This area is similar to Ember Clutch in Howling Fjord. The fire here never spreads beyond certain bounds, and it also never runs out of fuel within. This is where the proto-dragons of the region live wild, flapping between the burning trees. Scalding Water Lord is a water revenant summoned for the Horde quest Full of Hot Water. Under his picture in the quest frame, it says, "Alternative recreational uses for scalding water elementals have proven too dangerous to pursue on a commercial level." Additionally, one of his abilities called Boiling Burn increases fire damage taken by 25%, with the flavor text, "Danger: Elementals may be scalding hot!"

Saxifrage is a sturdy herb of the Dragon Isles that can grow in a multitude of places. While generally found in rugged locations like mountains or on cliffs, it can also be found upon the open plains or scarcely within volcanic regions. It can spawn rarely in 4 variants: Frigid, Lush, Titan-Touched, and Windswept.
The Scarlet Leggings are mail leggings that increase strength and stamina.

The Scarlet Onslaught is a faction that splintered off the Scarlet Crusade, and traveled to Northrend in the hopes of defeating the Lich King. On the frozen continent, they built their new capital New Hearthglen in Dragonblight, where Brigitte Abbendis led their operations, and the Onslaught Harbor in Icecrown to fight the Scourge. Formed from the most zealous and racist members of the original Crusade, the Onslaught appears to care little about the Crusade's wishes, as it employs shadowy raven priests, warlocks, and even death knights into its ranks. Following the war against the Lich King, the Onslaught was largely dismantled, but ideologies aren't so easily killed. During the Burning Legi

Scarlet Point is an area located east of the Crystal Vice, west of Light's Trust, and directly in front of Frostmourne Cavern in the Dragonblight. Two scout towers can be found here: the Scarlet Tower and another one that is still under construction. It is unknown why the Scarlet Onslaught is interested in such cavern, but they have fortified it heavily. Following the war against the Jailer, the brothers Bronzebeard reported that the outpost is a shattered, half-finished fortification, but didn't mention the presence of the crusaders. It is unknown if they managed to sneak past them, or if the outpost was abandoned after the fall of the Onslaught's leadership.

When Gebler moves to follow his orders, she uses her powers to kill him instead.

Scare Bear is an achievement earned by ensuring that Tur Ragepaw is alive while defeating the Ursoc encounter in the Emerald Nightmare instance, on Normal difficulty or higher. After clearing the trash packs before the boss, Tur Ragepaw will join the raid in fighting Ursoc. He will take damage throughout the fight, and can be healed by normal healing abilities. Simply ensure that he is healed enough to remain alive, and when Ursoc is defeated the achievement will be awarded.

The Scholomance (SKOH-loh-mance), a vile academy for prospective necromancers of the Scourge, is located in the ruins of the palatial House of Barov, on a rise overlooking the abandoned city of Caer Darrow. The enemy level range is 57-62.

The Scorched Grove is an area of southwestern Eversong Woods that has been completely burned down by the blood elves in an attempt to halt the Scourge forces and the spreading of the soil-tainting blight. Such extreme measures were thought to be necessary, as the runestones that protected the Woods were mostly destroyed by the Scourge. The Grove is now populated by several aggressive treants who defiantly try to nurture life back into the burned soil. A deactivated runestone sits there.
